articles.title: OpenAI Launches GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI released GPT-5 Turbo, featuring deeply integrated multimodal reasoning that can simultaneously process and cross-reference video, audio, code, and text within a single inference pass. Benchmarks show a 40% improvement over GPT-5 on complex multi-step engineering tasks, with significantly reduced hallucination rates. The model also introduces a persistent memory architecture that maintains context across sessions for enterprise users.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves Near-Human Performance on Graduate-Level Scientific Research Tasks
articles.summary: DeepMind published results showing Gemini Ultra 2 scoring within 3% of expert human researchers on a new benchmark designed to test open-ended scientific hypothesis generation and experimental design. The model demonstrated the ability to propose novel protein-folding mechanisms that were subsequently validated in wet-lab experiments. This marks a significant step toward AI systems that can actively contribute to the scientific discovery pipeline rather than merely assisting with it.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Begins Limited Deployment in Amazon Warehouses
articles.summary: Tesla's third-generation Optimus humanoid robot has entered pilot deployment at three Amazon fulfillment centers, handling pick-and-place operations alongside human workers. The Gen 3 units feature improved dexterous manipulation with 22 degrees of freedom per hand and a new vision-language-action model that allows them to interpret natural language task instructions in real time. Early reports suggest the robots achieve roughly 70% of human worker throughput on targeted tasks, with Amazon evaluating broader rollout in Q1 2027.

articles.title: Boston Dynamics and Hyundai Unveil Atlas Commercial Platform with Fully Autonomous Construction Capabilities
articles.summary: Boston Dynamics formally launched the commercial Atlas platform purpose-built for construction sites, capable of autonomously carrying heavy materials across uneven terrain, operating power tools, and performing basic structural inspection using onboard LiDAR and thermal imaging. The system uses a hierarchical planning framework that decomposes high-level building plans into granular manipulation tasks. Several major construction firms in South Korea and the U.S. have signed pilot agreements for deployment starting early 2027.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Constitutional AI Oversight Framework Adopted by EU AI Office
articles.summary: Anthropic published a formal Constitutional AI Oversight (CAIO) framework that provides auditable, mechanistic interpretability checkpoints for frontier AI systems, and the EU AI Office announced it will incorporate the framework into its compliance guidelines under the AI Act. The framework includes standardized red-teaming protocols and real-time alignment monitoring dashboards. This represents the first time a major regulatory body has endorsed a specific technical safety framework from an AI lab.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm Process Node, Powering Next-Generation AI Accelerators
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production on its N1.4 process node at its Kaohsiung fab, delivering a 25% performance uplift and 35% power reduction over its 2nm node. The first customer chips are AI inference accelerators destined for hyperscaler data centers, with NVIDIA and Broadcom confirmed as early adopters. The milestone cements TSMC's manufacturing lead and is expected to significantly reduce the cost-per-token for large-scale AI inference workloads by mid-2027.

articles.title: Microsoft and Quantinuum Demonstrate First Fault-Tolerant Quantum Advantage on a Real-World Optimization Problem
articles.summary: Microsoft and Quantinuum jointly announced they have achieved quantum advantage on a logistics supply-chain optimization problem using their integrated hybrid quantum-classical system with 56 logical qubits and error rates below the fault-tolerance threshold. The system solved a vehicle routing problem instance 12x faster than the best known classical algorithm on equivalent hardware budgets. While the problem scope remains narrow, it is widely regarded as the first commercially meaningful demonstration of fault-tolerant quantum computing.

articles.title: Figure AI Raises $1.5B Series C to Scale Humanoid Robot Manufacturing, Announces Partnership with BMW
articles.summary: Figure AI closed a $1.5 billion Series C round at a $15 billion valuation, with funds earmarked for building a dedicated humanoid robot manufacturing facility in Texas. Simultaneously, the company announced an expanded partnership with BMW to deploy its Figure 03 robots across multiple European assembly plants for complex sub-assembly tasks. The Figure 03 features an updated foundation model trained on over 100,000 hours of teleoperation data, enabling generalized manipulation without task-specific programming.
